text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 472 August 12, 1976
MAKING THE CHAIRMAN, ENERGY DEVELOPMENT BOARD A MEMBER OF THE CABINET
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby order that the Chairman of the Energy Development Board shall be a member of the Cabinet with all
the rights, honors and privileges pertaining to the position.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
